messages:
Asha (PM): Sprintly pilot just sent a hard ask — they need token latency around ~50ms for short prompts. They want us to enable a 'fast-path' low-precision variant for their tenant during the pilot. Need a scope call: include behind a feature flag in MVP or punt to v1? Need decision by EOD so Sales can respond.

Mike (Eng): Fast-path is doable but risky. Lower precision + different kernel path can regress quality and needs extra perf/QA. Rough estimate: 2-3 dev sprints to make it safe at scale. We could ship behind an alpha flag with conservative rollout and strict telemetry/rollback.

Jordan (Solutions): Sprintly will run short burst prompts, so latency matters more than highest-perf quality for them. They're willing to accept experimental label and a smaller sample size if we gate it. Their pilot start is two weeks out.

Olivia (Design): UX concern — if we expose a toggled experience we need clear copy and an easy fallback. Users must understand "fast" vs "stable". Also want to ensure we don't accidentally show degraded responses as product defaults.

Sam (SRE): We can canary-route Sprintly to isolated pools. Recommend pre-warming KV cache and a regional canary (us-west2) to meet latency target. Need autoscaling policy tweaks for the low-latency path.

Mike (Eng): Proposed rollout config (PR will have this):
```
rollout:
  flag: alpha_fast_path
  percent: 10
  canary_region: us-west2
  rollback_on_error: true
```
We'll wire p50/p95 latency, error-rate, and a quality-regression metric from our eval harness. If hallucination or quality drop exceeds threshold, auto-roll back.

Asha (PM): Proposed decision: approve fast-path behind feature flag for MVP with 10% canary in us-west2. Acceptance gates: error-rate delta <= 0.5% and quality drop (regression suite) <= 2%. Timeline: flag ready for internal canary tomorrow, public pilot canary within 48h, final go/no-go in 2 weeks based on metrics. Jordan — can you confirm Sprintly can accept experimental label and that retention of the pilot depends on this?

Jordan (Solutions): @Asha I'll loop in Sprintly now and confirm; they verbally said yes to experimental. I'll get written sign-off.

Olivia (Design): I'll prepare small UI copy options: "Fast (experimental)" and "Switch to stable". Also a micro-interstitial explaining tradeoffs.

Mike (Eng): I'll add telemetry hooks for latency p50/p95, hallucination-rate (eval), and a traffic split monitor. Will open PR for the rollout config and a canary dashboard.

Sam (SRE): Noted. I'll schedule an isolated pod pool and tweak autoscale. Also adding alert: if canary cpu or GPU saturates >80% or p95 exceeds 120ms we trigger rollback.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued: canary rollout scheduled at 1718466600 (us-west2, 10%).

Asha (PM): OK — decision recorded. I'll update roadmap/milestone tracker and add a note to the Sprintly pilot doc: "fast-path experimental flag; watch metrics; rollback if gates fail." Closing loop here unless anyone has blockers.

Jordan (Solutions): :thumbsup: will share Sprintly sign-off here when I have it.

Mike (Eng): One last ask — we should run the regression suite with 2x prompt jitter (short/long) before canary. Will kick that off tonight.

Olivia (Design): Thanks — mockups incoming.

Asha (PM): Thanks team. I'll post an update to the milestone board and ping sales/stakeholders after Jordan confirms.
